content_sections.heading: IIM Bodh Gaya Faculty Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: For academic positions, the qualification, experience and related requirements are governed by the Ministry of Education guidelines. Candidates should have a demonstrated ability to make relevant intellectual contribution to experienced and potential managers through teaching, training research and published work. Candidates should also have a strong academic background and understanding of current developments in the related field. Faculty members are expected to carry out research, design and teach courses, engage in institution development, and conduct training programs and consultancy. Meeting the minimum qualifications and experience does not by itself entitle a candidate to be called for the interview.

content_sections.heading: IIM Bodh Gaya Faculty Salary
content_sections.text: The notification gives the following pay scale under the 7th CPC and the entry pay for each faculty position. The pay carries all other allowances such as DA, HRA/Leased Accommodation, LTC, Medical re-imbursement, Children Education Allowance, NPS, re-imbursement of telephone bills, incentive for research publications, faculty development fund for attending national and international conferences, membership of professional bodies etc. as per IIM Bodh Gaya Rules. Faculty members are permitted to pursue management consulting with income sharing with the Institute as per rules. The maximum consolidated remuneration for the Senior Consultant (Academics) post on contract is Rs. 1,50,000/- per month. In addition, the notification mentions accommodation on campus subject to availability or a fixed HRA of Rs. 15000/-, actual telephone reimbursement up to Rs. 1500/- pm, and medical allowances as per IIM Bodh Gaya Rules.

content_sections.heading: IIM Bodh Gaya Faculty Selection Process
content_sections.text: The notification does not list the selection stages in detail. It mentions the following points about how applications are handled: Papers published ONLY in ABDC Journals will be considered for shortlisting of applications. In case of overwhelming applications, the Screening Committee might use academic/publication/work-experience parameters as criteria for raising the bar and optimizing the application pool. Mere fulfillment of the qualifications and experience does not entitle a candidate to be called for the interview. Candidates called for interview to fill a vacancy may be considered for lower posts if they are otherwise found suitable. Depending on the academic credentials of the candidate, the Institute may consider them for an offer on a contractual basis of one/two years. For regular appointments, there would be a probation period of 2 years. The list of waitlisted candidates will remain valid for 1 year from the date of declaration of result. Reservation Policy will apply as per the Government of India Rules.
